title: The Book of Obadiah Timeline
sub: Judgment on Edom · the Day of the LORD on All Nations
desc: The Old Testament's shortest book, a single-chapter oracle against Edom for gloating over Jerusalem's fall and joining in its plunder, widening to a promise that the kingdom itself will belong to the LORD.

events.title: The Vision of Obadiah: Edom's Pride Will Bring It Down
events.detail: A vision against Edom, Israel's kin descended from Esau, whose cliff-top fortresses and false security are declared no match for the LORD [Yahweh], who will bring them down and strip away their wisdom.

verses.text: “Your presumptuous heart has deceived you—you who reside in the safety of the rocky cliffs… I can bring you down even from there!” says the LORD [Yahweh].

events.title: Violence to Your Brother Jacob: Standing Aloof on the Day of Disaster
events.detail: Edom's specific crime is named: standing by, and even joining in, while foreigners plundered Jerusalem and cast lots for the city, betraying a covenant of brotherhood with Jacob's descendants.

verses.text: “Because you violently slaughtered your relatives, the people of Jacob, shame will cover you, and you will be destroyed forever.”

events.title: The Day of the LORD Draws Near: the Kingdom Will Belong to the LORD
events.detail: The oracle widens from Edom alone to all nations facing a coming day of reckoning, closing with the delivered ascending Mount Zion and a declaration that the LORD [Yahweh] himself will reign as King.

verses.text: “Those who have been delivered will go up on Mount Zion in order to rule over Esau's mountain. Then the LORD [Yahweh] will reign as King!”
